dispositions.ru-A1 MAJOR keep_generations.label noun: RESOLVED: the noun is restored («Хранить неактивных установок», 28 cells). The «неисп.» rejection is upheld (the style guide endorses no such abbreviation). Residual term mismatch → ru-B1 MINOR.
dispositions.ru-A3 MINOR keep verb x3: RESOLVED: «хранить» used throughout (label, both choices, help).
dispositions.ru-A4 MINOR width choice.true 50: RESOLVED: 38 cells. The auto_prune.help 90-cell part is accepted, since help gets two rows.

findings.problem: The label says «неактивных» (inactive) where the help in the same row says «неиспользуемых» (unused). «Неактивная установка» can be read as "not the current one", which would also cover a non-current install a running session still uses. The help's always-kept sentence rules that reading out, and the misreading only makes a user expect to keep fewer installs than are actually kept, so nothing unsafe follows. The full term does not fit: «Хранить неиспользуемых установок» is 32 cells against 29. The translator rejected «неисп.» because the ru style guide endorses only «мин»/«сек» and says «настр.» needs a recorded decision. That rejection is a fair reading of the guide.
findings.suggested: Accept and record as a ru width exception in the style guide (as with earlier recorded exceptions), or record «неисп.» as an endorsed abbreviation and use «Хранить неисп. установок» (24). Non-gating.
